attributes.additional_details: make Summerween official and bring it to the UK calendar.
attributes.background: Halloween has a huge following, but can be ruined by the winter weather, we propose adding an official SUMMERWEEN date celebrating all things spooky in the middle of school summer holidays to give the UK two chances of an EPIC spooky evening.

rejection.details:
We can only accept petitions about things the Government or Parliament are directly responsible for.

Decisions about whether to celebrate Summerween are a matter for individuals, not the UK Government or Parliament.
